findings.title: New App tests name two undeclared direct crates
findings.description: The four new tests directly name http_body_util and hyper, but actual immutable App/Cargo.toml declares neither crate. Only hyper-util is a direct App dependency. Cargo.lock/transitive dependency presence does not introduce those extern-crate names into this target, so the requested all-target compilation cannot resolve these new paths.
findings.required_change: Use direct existing Axum Body::into_data_stream plus futures::StreamExt for exact data-item consumption, and existing hyper_util connection Builder/TowerToHyperService with an Axum Router for genuine HTTP1; preserve all four named behaviors and old test prefix. A fresh revision is required; do not edit V2.

scope: Full new production and authored four-test review plus exact independent parent Source10 lineage; unknown stream and all old tests retained byte-exact.
source_conclusion: No additional concrete production defect found in the new exact-length state machine. Current V2 is not approved because the newly authored App test crate paths cannot resolve under the actual manifest.
